title: SkyrimNet Dialogue Scenario Editor
tagline: Write scenarios that nearby NPCs play out - narration, lines spoken in their own voice, OStim scenes - or let an NPC write the whole scenario for you with SkyrimNet's AI.
description:
**For adult players.** Scenarios can end in sex scenes (OStim or SexLab).

Write short scenarios that real NPCs play out when you meet them: who takes part, what the situation is, who says what, and how each part ends. Or let an NPC write the whole scenario for you. SkyrimNet's AI speaks every line in the speaker's own voice, so the same scenario fits any character.

## Scenarios in columns
A scenario has up to 10 columns, played from left to right. Each column has 1 to 3 people (the player too), a narration that sets the situation, up to 10 lines in any order (anyone may speak several times), and what ends the column: nothing (talk only), a sex scene with the tags you pick (OStim, or SexLab P+ / 1.6x), move and wait (chosen people walk to an interior and wait there until another scenario has happened or some days have passed), or a SkyrimNet action one of them does (picked from the actions of the mods you have installed, such as SeverActions, with its parameters). The same person may appear in several columns; a column with one person can be a masturbation scene.

## Lines in the speaker's own voice
A line is not read out word for word: SkyrimNet is told that the speaker is about to say something that means it, and the AI words it the way that character would. Your own lines are spoken by your character through SkyrimNet.

## Auto lines
Switch a single line to Auto, or a whole column (Short 3, Medium 6, Long 10 lines): the AI makes those lines up when they are spoken, from the column's narration, the columns before and after, and the talk so far.

## Generate
Pick a scenario writer (an NPC), 2 to 10 people (NPCs and you), the number of columns and, if you like, a theme. The writer writes every column in their own style: the people of each column, the narration, the lines with their speakers, and where a sex scene fits, with tags. It draws on the people's bios, memories, recent events and latest diary entries, and on the relationship maps of SN Sexual Memories when there are any. The result goes into the editor, where you check it, change what you like and save. Generate (auto lines) writes only the people, narration and sex scenes (tags) of each column and leaves the lines to Auto (Medium). Its model is set in the dashboard: AI > Models, dialogue_scenario_writer (left empty, the default model is used). One request for the plot, then one per column.

## When it starts
Automatically when everyone in it is near you, or when you press the scenario hotkey (set in the MCM), your choice per scenario. You also choose whether others may be around or only the people in it; indoors, outdoors or anywhere, or only in one cell (an interior from the list, or the cell you are in); once or again every few days; and whether another scenario must have finished first.

## How a column plays
The people walk over to you and stay together while they talk; anyone who does not arrive within a few seconds is moved over. Then the column's end (a sex scene, move and wait, or an action) follows and the next column begins at once. People who are fighting, in a scene, or busy with what an action started are left to it: they talk from where they are.

## Settings page
Made and changed on an in-game page (Magelight UI or Prisma UI), opened with a key you set in the MCM. Scenarios are saved as files, the same for every save; whether one has already happened is kept in the save.

## When something goes wrong
The mod writes what it does to SKSE\SkyrimNet_DialogueScenarioEditor.log in Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition: why a scenario is not starting, and while one runs, every line and SkyrimNet's speech events. It is made new at every game start.

## Requirements
SKSE64, Address Library, SkyrimNet with an AI model set up, OStim Standalone or SexLab (P+ or 1.6x) for sex scenes (either one; without them the talk, move and wait and actions still work), PapyrusUtil SE, powerofthree's Papyrus Extender, MCM Helper, SkyUI, and Magelight UI or Prisma UI for the settings page. SN Sexual Memories is optional. It adds no prompt that replaces one of SkyrimNet's own.

## Known limits
Tested on Skyrim 1.6.1170 with Magelight UI; the Prisma UI page has not been tested in game yet. An NPC sitting in a chair may not stand up to walk over and is moved over instead. SexLab support is not tested in game yet. SkyrimNet itself can pick actions from what the narration and lines say, apart from the column-end action, more so with auto lines: to have an action happen exactly where you put it, let the narration lead up to it and let the column-end action start it. The installer offers the settings menu and page in English or Japanese.

changelog:
New
- A SkyrimNet action at the end of a column: pick an action from the mods you have installed (SeverActions, OStimNet, SkyrimNet SexLab, Relationships and others), who does it, and its parameters. Only actions SkyrimNet has registered in your game are offered; one whose mod was removed later is skipped.
- SexLab support (P+ and 1.6x): the MCM setting "Sex scenes with" (Automatic / OStim / SexLab) chooses when both are installed; Automatic uses OStim. Scenario tags keep OStim's names and SexLab gets the nearest SexLab tags. Not tested in game yet.
- OStim is no longer needed: without OStim or SexLab, scenarios still play their talk, move and wait, and actions.

Changed
- People who are fighting (a brawl too), in a sex scene, changed by an action or a move and wait earlier in the same scenario, or held by another mod's scene are no longer gathered or held. They still say their lines from where they are.
- Someone who fights while talking loses SkyrimNet's talk package (which keeps a speaker standing still), so they keep fighting.

Good to know
- SkyrimNet itself can pick actions from what the narration and lines say, apart from the column-end action; auto lines make this more likely.
